author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
In this video, we take you to Guangde, my hometown in Anhui Province, for a glimpse into everyday life in one of China’s more “ordinary” cities. We explore peaceful tea plantations, get invited to a local lunch, and experience the quiet charm of the region. Known for its bamboo forests and surprisingly cozy café scene, Guangde shows a more authentic, slower side of China that you don’t often see.
And eventually we met my family! I hope you will enjoy 🎬
